page_title: SEV 2-3 ALA | Sevilla v Alaves 12/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+6' The current number of shots on goal is 4:8.
90+3' Substitution. Victor Parada Gonzalez has come on for Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
90+2' Kike Garcia (Alaves) gets a yellow card.
90+2' Substitution. Ander Guevara makes way for Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 3 Goal! Nice headed pass by Samu Omorodion to Ruben Duarte (Alaves), who latches on to it and puts the ball into the back of the net with a fine header. 2:3.
90' Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
86' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Mariano Diaz (Sevilla), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post.
83' Suso (Sevilla) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Antonio Sivera has no trouble gathering it.
82' 2 - 2 Goal! Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Antonio Sivera into the middle of the goal.
81' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
81' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
81' It’s a PENALTY to Sevilla after the VAR review!

80' Play continues despite the shouts by some Sevilla players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
79' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
77' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Jon Guridi is replaced by Alex Sola (Alaves).
77' Substitution. Ruben Duarte (Alaves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Luis Rioja walks off.
75' What was Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
73' A player from Sevilla commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
72' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Kike Garcia will be replaced by Samu Omorodion (Alaves).
70' 1 - 2 Rafa Mir (Sevilla) displays good awareness in the six-yard box and finds an unusual way to score by using his body to knock the ball behind the keeper. He makes it 1:2.
69' We are about to witness a subsitution. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) for Jesus Navas.

68' A neat pass is well received by Kike Garcia (Alaves), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
67' 13:12 – the total goal attempt statistics.
67' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot low towards the middle of the net that is easily dealt with by Marko Dmitrovic.
66' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
65' Golden chance! Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
64' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
62' A pass by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
61' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
61' Rafa Mir (Sevilla) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for an infringement.
60' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Marcao (Sevilla).
58' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' That's the end of the game for Boubakary Soumare, who is replaced by Rafa Mir (Sevilla).
56' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to make a change. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) replaces Ivan Rakitic.
56' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Substitution. Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) replaces Isaac Romero Bernal.
55' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Carlos Vicente (Alaves). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
49' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' The linesman raises his flag. Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) is adjudged offside.
48' The attendance is 34225.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

45+2' Kike Garcia (Alaves) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the top right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a superb reflex save and punches the ball onto the post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Quique Sanchez Flores is forced to make a change. Kike Salas is unable to continue due to injury, Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) comes on.
40' 0 - 2 Goal! Javi Lopez gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Kike Garcia (Alaves), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 0:2.
40' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Luis Rioja (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
35' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
32' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a long ball in, but Marko Dmitrovic comfortably gathers the ball.
30' Great teamplay by Alaves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! The corner comes over and Jon Guridi flicks on with his head to Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
26' Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
23' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Rafa Marin (Alaves) is given a yellow card.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
21' A cross into the box from Javi Lopez (Alaves) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
19' Suso (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
16' The corner from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is hurriedly cleared.
16' Sevilla will take a free kick near the side line.
14' Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.

12' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla).
10' Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).
8' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) whips the ball into the box and Lucas Ocampos takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
8' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' What a miss! The corner finds Kike Salas (Sevilla) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
7' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) steps up to send the ball in.
6' Suso (Sevilla) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Sevilla get a corner.
6' Suso (Sevilla) and Ivan Rakitic combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
4' Sevilla enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Crossbar! Jesus Navas (Sevilla) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
2' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Suso (Sevilla).

2' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Isaac Romero Bernal (Sevilla) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
1' Isaac Romero Bernal finds some space and receives a very precise long pass from Oliver Torres (Sevilla).
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez was nominated as the referee for this game.
